prompt: Style these roads as simple lines
criteria: Must include paint.color property (never omit it)
Color must be from SimplePalette (HSL format like 'hsl(61,40%,45%)') or a reasonable single color - NOT an array of colors
Must use default size: 2 (not 3, not 4, not any other value)
Should use default lineCap and lineJoin: 'round'
